verdict.rationale: Community evidence (svelte-comm-13) confirms Svelte shipped built-in accessibility checking that developers praised as reducing reliance on separate audit tools, and docs mention a CLI check (`sv check`, svelte-docs-13) that could surface such warnings, but there is no first-party documentation in the pack explicitly detailing the compiler's accessibility warning system (e.g., a11y-alt-text, a11y-click-events-have-key-events) or how it integrates into the dev workflow. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs describing the built-in a11y warning rules and dev-server integration, plus more independent hands-on confirmation of its coverage.
